notes: §1989:A.2.19.3 AR1: "Argument-1 may be a nonnumeric literal or a data item of any class or category." BindLengthFamily binds the one argument at every edition and BindLengthFold measures a nonnumeric literal and a data item of every class (probed at 85: group 14, COMP-3 3, COMP 2, INDEX 8, numeric edited 9, alphabetic 4, SIGN SEPARATE 4, reference-modified 3, OCCURS DEPENDING group 7) and refuses a numeric literal and an arithmetic expression with COBOL1627; what 2023 adds is refused at 85 by edition gates (national and boolean literals by LiteralScreen.GateFormat, PHYSICAL by BindLengthFamily's construct check, all COBOL0900). The witness measures a literal, an alphanumeric item and a numeric item. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Validation/VersionConformancePass.cs#VisitNonNumericLiteral (kb/Work PB5416: the version pass's statement-scoped national/boolean literal gate is deleted; the literal token's format gate, LiteralScreen.GateFormat, refuses N, NX, B and BX literals at 85 wherever they are written)

next.reason: 1985: "Argument-1 may be a nonnumeric literal or a data item of any class or category."; 2023: "an alphanumeric, national, or boolean literal; a data item of any class or category; a based entry; or a type-name". The 2023 LENGTH rule keeps literal and any-class data item arguments, and adds national and boolean literals, based entries and type-names as permitted argument-1.
